title: Voorbrug, Delft (Camdeboo St, approx.): 2 men shot dead, 3 Oct
summary: Delft police registered a double murder case after two men were shot dead in Camdeboo Street, Anceba Court, Voorbrug, at about 18:40 on Saturday 3 October; both were declared dead at the scene and the motive is unknown (...
story: Delft police registered a double murder case after two men were shot dead in Camdeboo Street, Anceba Court, Voorbrug, at about 18:40 on Saturday 3 October; both were declared dead at the scene and the motive is unknown (police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). Both outlets carry the same police statement.
location_note: Camdeboo Street, Anceba Court, Voorbrug, Delft (exact spot not given). OpenStreetMap has the street as Camdeboo Crescent; the pin is on it.
basis: Both reports rest on the same police statement; not independent confirmation.

provenance.note: Two reports written separately; the same two articles also cover the other Delft shooting. The shooting facts come from police spokesperson Const. Ndakhe Gwala in both. Daily Voice adds a resident and TygerBurger adds a DA spokesperson.

sources.name: Constable Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS
sources.quote: They were both declared deceased on the scene by medical personnel.

sources.name: Constable Ndakhe Gwala, SAPS

facts.label: Reported motive
facts.claim: Police motive undetermined; local watch member speculates about gangs or extortion.
facts.detail: Police say motive yet to be determined in TygerBurger. Local watch comment speaks broadly about killings, and incident-specific knowledge is not shown.

sources.name: Unidentified Delft Neighbourhood Watch member
sources.quote: A Delft Neighbourhood Watch member, who asked not to be identified, alleged that the killings could be gang-related or linked to extortion.

facts.label: Legal status
facts.claim: Double-murder case registered; arrests not stated.
